Title: Vyper: Return inside for loop more than 1 level deep
Description: Impact is minor, it is unlikely a user would encounter this problem unless they were working with nested calls, and return statements inside calls. Even in that scenario, you would encounter a revert which should be noticeable with adequate testing. In limited circumstances, this could cause a DoS attack for public contracts under certain conditions.
NotImpacted: All versions before 0.1.0-b.10, all versions starting from 0.2.3
